name: io.github.LuSrodri/render-useful-mcp
title: Render Useful MCP
description: MCP server for the Render Public API: all 207 endpoints plus workflow tools.

environmentVariables.name: RENDER_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default workspace, applied wherever a tool needs an ownerId and the caller omitted one.

environmentVariables.name: RENDER_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose, or 'all'. Defaults to all 17 toolsets.

environmentVariables.name: RENDER_MCP_DYNAMIC_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Let the model enable toolsets mid-session via the render_toolsets tool.
